interpretation: The first four unique-edge buckets account for 232.83 bytes per ring-ready record of the 234.96-byte collector-resolution total. The immutable ResolvedSyscall counter is a nested construction counter and is not additive. The two decision-observer buckets are incurred by TierEKernelSmoke's benchmark correctness oracle, not by a normal collector constructed without an observer. Production collector overhead therefore requires a separately retained observer-free measurement before it can be classified as unavoidable.
